description.de: Schreibt einen Test für eine konkrete Klasse aus einem TODO. Pro Klasse ein Commit, bei Fehler verwerfen.
description.en: Writes a test for a specific class from a TODO. One commit per class, discard on failure.

instructions:
You write tests for the MySuricates project. RULES: 1) Write/change ONLY test files, NEVER production code. 2) JUnit 5 + Mockito + AssertJ. 3) Use existing test patterns as a template. 4) After writing: run mvn test -Dtest=NewTest.

Run isolation: work only in {{ execution_path }}. The original path {{ project_path }} identifies the project and must not be written to. No automatic merges, pushes or switches to main/master. Changes stay on the run branch for explicit adoption. If a technical check failed, a report must not claim success. Checked commit: {{ workspace_source_sha }}; logs: {{ workspace_logs }}.

config.label: Load the TODO context
config.command:
BASE={{ execution_path }}

echo '========================================'
echo '  TASK'
echo '========================================'
echo 'TODO title: {{ todo_title }}'
echo 'TODO description: {{ todo_description }}'
echo ''

echo '========================================'
echo '  ANALYZE THE TARGET CLASS'
echo '========================================'
# Try to extract the class from the TODO title
CLASS_NAME=$(echo '{{ todo_title }}' | grep -oE '[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+' | head -1)
echo "Detected class: $CLASS_NAME"

# Find the source file
SRC=$(find "$BASE/ai-automation-backend/src/main/java" -name "${CLASS_NAME}.java" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -n "$SRC" ]; then
  echo "Source: $SRC"
  echo "LOC: $(wc -l < "$SRC")"
  echo ''
  echo '--- Public methods ---'
  grep -n 'public ' "$SRC" | grep -v 'class \|interface ' | head -20
else
  echo "Source NOT FOUND for: $CLASS_NAME"
  # Broader search
  echo '--- Similar files ---'
  find "$BASE/ai-automation-backend/src/main/java" -name "*${CLASS_NAME}*" 2>/dev/null | head -5
  find "$BASE/ai-automation-frontend/src" -name "*${CLASS_NAME}*" 2>/dev/null | head -5
fi

# Check whether a test already exists
TEST=$(find "$BASE/ai-automation-backend/src/test/java" -name "${CLASS_NAME}Test.java" -o -name "${CLASS_NAME}Tests.java" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -n "$TEST" ]; then
  echo ''
  echo "Existing test: $TEST"
  echo "Test LOC: $(wc -l < "$TEST")"
  echo "Test methods: $(grep -c '@Test' "$TEST")"
else
  echo ''
  echo 'No existing test'
fi

echo ''
echo '========================================'
echo '  REFERENCE TESTS (same package)'
echo '========================================'
if [ -n "$SRC" ]; then
  PKG_DIR=$(dirname "$SRC" | sed 's|src/main/java|src/test/java|')
  if [ -d "$PKG_DIR" ]; then
    ls "$PKG_DIR"/*Test.java 2>/dev/null | head -3 | while read tf; do
      echo "Reference: $(basename $tf) ($(grep -c '@Test' "$tf") tests)"
    done
  else
    echo '(no test package present)'
  fi
fi

config.label: Write the test (Opus)
config.goal:
Write a test for the class from the TODO.

CONTEXT:
{{ previous_output }}

OPEN TODOS (for context):
{{ open_todos }}

PROCEDURE:
1. Read the source file completely
2. If a test exists: read it and add the missing test methods
3. If no test exists: read 1-2 reference tests in the same package as a template
4. Write the test:
   - JUnit 5 (@Test, @BeforeEach, @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class))
   - @Mock for all dependencies, @InjectMocks for the target class
   - Naming: should_<expected>_when_<condition>
   - AssertJ assertions (assertThat)
   - At least: happy path + error path for every important public method
   - Edge cases for critical logic
5. Run the test: cd {{ execution_path }}/ai-automation-backend && mvn test -Dtest="<TestName>" -q
6. If the test fails: fix it and run it again
7. When the test passes: git add + git commit with the message 'test: Add tests for <ClassName>'

IMPORTANT:
- Absolute paths: {{ execution_path }}/...
- Create/change ONLY test files, NEVER production code
- If the class is not found: report an error and stop
- If mvn test does not pass after 3 attempts: discard the changes (git checkout) and report the error
config.success_criteria: Test file created, mvn test passes, commit created.

config.label: Explain the result
config.command:
Summarize the result in at most 5 lines:

{{ previous_output }}

- Which class was tested
- How many test methods were written
- Whether the tests passed
- Whether a commit was created

gate_status: GREEN if the test passes and is committed, YELLOW if the test passes but is not committed, RED if the test fails

config.label: Gate-Verdict
config.command:
PREV={{ previous_output }}

if echo "$PREV" | grep -qi 'gate_status: RED'; then
  echo 'Test-Sync: FAILED'
  echo 'gate_status: RED'
  echo 'gate_category: test-sync'
  echo 'gate_description: Test could not be written'
elif echo "$PREV" | grep -qi 'gate_status: YELLOW'; then
  echo 'Test-Sync: PARTIAL'
  echo 'gate_status: YELLOW'
  echo 'gate_category: test-sync'
  echo 'gate_description: Test written, manual review recommended'
elif echo "$PREV" | grep -qi 'gate_status: GREEN'; then
  echo 'Test-Sync: SUCCESSFUL'
  echo 'gate_status: GREEN'
  echo 'gate_category: test-sync'
  echo 'gate_description: Test written, verified and committed'
else
  echo 'Test-Sync: INCOMPLETE'
  echo 'gate_status: YELLOW'
  echo 'gate_category: test-sync'
  echo 'gate_description: Result incomplete — no gate status in the report (AI block failed or unclear)'
fi
